title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 13
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q121_make_history
elements.title: The athlete hoped to ___ by becoming the first person from her country to win the event.

elements.name: q122_ode_to
elements.title: The film is an ___ to railway workers, celebrating their skill and dedication.

elements.name: q123_pizzazz
elements.title: The performance had plenty of ___, thanks to its bold costumes and energetic dancing.

elements.name: q124_covertly
elements.title: They rehearsed ___ so their friends would not find out about the surprise performance.

elements.name: q125_hit_on_someone
elements.title: In informal English, what does it mean to “hit on someone” at a party?
choices: Show romantic interest by flirting with them
Ask them to leave the party
elements.correctAnswer: Show romantic interest by flirting with them

elements.name: q126_troll
elements.title: A user began to ___ the discussion, posting insulting comments just to upset people.

elements.name: q127_stark
elements.title: The report draws a ___ contrast between the two towns: one is thriving while the other is losing jobs.

elements.name: q128_hold_your_breath
elements.title: Which figurative meaning fits “Fans are holding their breath for the final result”?
choices: They are ignoring the result completely.
They are waiting with nervous anticipation.
They are competing to see who can stay underwater longest.
They think the result is already final.
elements.correctAnswer: They are waiting with nervous anticipation.

elements.name: q129_every_second_counts
elements.title: When an urgent deadline is moments away, what does “every second counts” mean?
choices: The deadline can safely be ignored.

elements.name: q130_ground_zero
elements.title: What does “ground zero” mean in “The neighbourhood became ground zero for the new music scene”?
choices: It was the last place the music reached.
It was a place where music was banned.
It was a venue the musicians avoided.
It was the place where the scene started.
elements.correctAnswer: It was the place where the scene started.
